<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;1,400&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;600&family=Libre+Baskerville:ital@1&display=swap');

  /* Kill Quarto's auto-generated title block on cover page */
  #title-block-header { display: none !important; }

  /* Scoped reset -- do NOT use * {} or it kills Quarto's navbar */
  .banner, .banner * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  .banner {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 60px);
    position: relative;
    background: #0e1a12;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .topo-layer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0.18;
  }

  .color-wash {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0e1a12 0%,
      #111f14 20%,
      #132418 35%,
      #111f14 55%,
      #0e1a12 75%,
      #0a140e 100%
    );
  }

  .grain {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.4'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    opacity: 0.06;
  }

  .blob1 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 500px;
    height: 500px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(180, 120, 40, 0.09) 0%, transparent 70%);
    top: -150px;
    right: 100px;
  }
  .blob2 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 350px;
    height: 350px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(80, 160, 90, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
    bottom: -100px;
    left: 200px;
  }
  .blob3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 280px;
    height: 280px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(200, 150, 60, 0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
    top: 50px;
    left: 500px;
  }

  .accent-bar {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 5px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c8922a 0%, #6aaa6e 50%, #e8b84b 100%);
  }

  .content {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 48px 64px 48px 80px;
  }

  .enter-button {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    color: #c8922a;
    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border: 1px solid #3a4a2a;
    padding: 12px 28px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: rgba(180, 120, 40, 0.06);
    transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
  }
  .enter-button:hover {
    background: rgba(180, 120, 40, 0.14);
    color: #e8b84b;
  }

  .banner-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 58px;
    line-height: 1.05;
    color: #f0ede6;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .banner-title .accent-word {
    color: #c8922a;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .banner-subtitle {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: #7a9a7d;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .tags {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .tag {
    font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: #5a7a4a;
    border: 1px solid #2a3a1e;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgba(80, 140, 60, 0.05);
  }

  .right-panel {
    position: absolute;
    right: 50px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 420px;
    height: 370px;
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  .bottom-rule {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 52px;
    left: 80px;
    right: 60px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2e3a1e, #1e2a18, transparent);
  }

  .credit {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 24px;

    font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: #3a5a2a;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
</style>
